# FRDTLAB

> FRDTLAB is a systems & intelligence lab for marketing — helping brands and small businesses win in AI-era search, integrated growth, and marketing infrastructure. Founded by Amanda Friedt (professionally also known as Amanda Farley), a Detroit-based growth and marketing operator, keynote speaker (SMX, Pubcon), and host of the Amplify podcast.

## Start here
- [The Lab (home)](https://frdtlab.com/): What FRDTLAB is and how it builds.
- [Frameworks](https://frdtlab.com/frameworks.html): The Integrated Marketing Intelligence System and the signal-flow model — marketing through the system, not on top of it.
- [In Motion](https://frdtlab.com/in-motion.html): Events, appearances, press, and recognition.
- [Work With Me](https://frdtlab.com/work-with-me.html): Advisory, workshops, and speaking.

## Services
- [Fractional CMO / VP of Growth](https://frdtlab.com/fractional-cmo.html): Senior marketing leadership part-time for companies at $1M–$50M — growth strategy plus the operating system underneath it. $5,000–$15,000/month. Detroit-rooted, remote across the US.
- [Fractional CMO in Detroit](https://frdtlab.com/fractional-cmo-detroit.html): Detroit-rooted fractional CMO / VP of Growth for Detroit and Michigan companies — in person locally, remote across the US. $5,000–$15,000/month.
- [AI Adoption for Marketing Teams](https://frdtlab.com/ai-adoption.html): Put AI to real work — campaign, content, reporting, and QA workflows with prompts, guardrails, and SOPs. $8,000–$25,000/project.
- [Marketing Operations & Systems](https://frdtlab.com/marketing-ops.html): Stack audit plus a connected, AI-ready marketing operating system. Audit $2,500, build $10,000–$30,000.

## Tools & products
- [Shop / Field Tools](https://frdtlab.com/shop.html): AI marketing tools and products.
- [AI Visibility Scorecard](https://frdtlab.com/scorecard.html): Free — can AI search engines see your brand? 10 questions, instant score.
- [AI Marketing Prompt Pack](https://frdtlab.com/prompt-pack.html): 50 operator-grade AI prompts. $49, instant PDF.

## Author
Amanda Friedt, also known as Amanda Farley. Detroit-based growth & marketing leader specializing in paid search, SEO, and AI-era (generative engine) optimization. Founder of FRDTLAB, creator of Unapologetic Leadership. LinkedIn: amandafriedt. Two decades in integrated marketing and AI-era search.
